title: 6th Anniversary Webpage and Wishing Wall Event
lines: A special 6th Anniversary event webpage. You can check out all the version info and activities there.
There's just so much information this time, so we've specially put everything together in one place—just in case you might miss anything!
Participate at:
https://6thanniversary.arknights.global
*We recommend participating in the event on your PC for an optimal experience.
6th Anniversary Wish Wall
Submit your wish and join the 6th Anniversary. Make a wish for reward!
The event will end on January 20 at 01:00 (UTC-7). Reward items will be sent to participants' in-game mail boxes.
How to Submit a Wish:
Log in and click "Make A Wish". Send your good wishes for the Arknights 6th Anniversary and click "Submit".
Each participant may submit up to 3 "Make A Wish" entries. Each wish is limited to 200 characters.
How to View Wishes:
Hit "Refresh" to see more content from other participants and a special surprise! (Limit: 30 times per day).
How to Claim Rewards:
Participation Reward:
Upon submitting a "Make A Wish" entry, you will receive a participation reward directly via in-game mail. Don't forget to log in and check it!
Lucky Prize Pool:
After the event ends on January 20th at 01:00, we'll randomly draw winners from all participants for these awesome prizes:
ATO Metal Pin Set: 10 winners
Hoshiguma the Breacher Finger Puppet Charm: 20 winners
$25 Gift Card: 20 winners
Each player is limited to winning one prize. The customer service team will contact winners via the email address provided during entry to arrange for prize delivery.
Additional Rules:
1. Players must reach Level 10 to participate in the event and claim rewards.
2. All in-game rewards for this event can only be claimed and used on the Arknights EN server.
3. All submitted content, names, and descriptions should not contain elements of politics, violence, pornography, grotesque or any other restricted by social platforms.
4. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at: arknights.event@yo-star.com .
